sources.title: The difference between The Witcher 3 and Witcher 4 will be 'comparable' to that of GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt boss says: 'I mean, it's been 11 years'
sources.text: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6. CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way. "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences. "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time. Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable: At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do." Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason. "You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero." Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments." "I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.' "They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that." Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.) seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed The Witcher 4 is currently slated for launch sometime in 2028, while Cyberpunk 2 isn't expected out before 2030. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. He began writing videogame news in 2007 for The Escapist and somehow managed to avoid getting fired until 2014, when he joined the storied ranks of PC Gamer. sources.title: GTA 6-Like Partnership With Playstation Announced by Witcher Developer
sources.text: CD Projetk Red and Sony are teaming up ahead of The Witcher 4 Expect to see a lot of "plays best on PlayStation" messaging when The Witcher 4 finally gets released in 2028 (if it doesn't get delayed). Developer CD Projekt Red has announced that it has entered into a marketing deal with PlayStation that will be similar to what Sony struck with Rockstar for Grand Theft Auto 6 . As part of CD Projekt Red's latest earnings report , CFO Piotr Nielubowicz said the company has "signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign." The deal will "support our business and financial outlook in this and future years." he continued. While details of the specific deal between CD Projekt Red and PlayStation were not shared, GTA 6 is a pretty good indicator of what we can expect. The Witcher 4 will likely be marketed almost exclusively for PlayStation consoles, highlighting specific features like the DualSense controller and PS5 Pro's superior power. The mention of PlayStation Plus suggests that subscribers could see The Witcher 3 return sometime in the future, perhaps after the release of the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion. Following the initial announcement of the deal, Michał Nowakowski (joint-CEO of CD Projekt RED) clarified to worried fans that The Witcher 4 will not be a PlayStation exclusive and is still planned for other platforms. The same is true for the studio's other upcoming titles, including Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 1 remake. That much was also true of Rockstar's deal with PlayStation, as GTA 6 was still released on Xbox Series X. It is still unclear how this will affect the possibility of a physical release for The Witcher 4 and other CD Projekt Red games, given Sony's plan to end disc production in 2028 for PlayStation games. In a recent interview, Nowakowski shared the studio's intent to still have a physical release but couldn't promise that it would include the game on an actual disc. "The discs for the first parties, including PlayStation, have to be manufactured in their own factories," he said, "So, if they stop manufacturing indeed by 2028, then yes [we won’t have a disc]." That seems to be the trend lately, with GTA 6 also forgoing a physical disc release.

sources.title: The Witcher 4 terá salto geracional parecido com o de GTA 5 para GTA 6, confirma CD Projekt RED
sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 já está disponível e certamente deve servir de inspiração para diversos estúdios da indústria nos próximos anos. A CD Projekt RED, por exemplo, acredita que a evolução de The Witcher 3 para The Witcher 4 será comparável ao salto técnico e visual de GTA 5 e a sequência da Rockstar. A informação foi compartilhada durante uma reunião com investidores, na qual os executivos da desenvolvedora polonesa responderam a perguntas sobre o novo RPG e também comentaram o lançamento de GTA 6 — considerado o maior da história do entretenimento . Apesar de reconhecer que os dois projetos possuem propostas diferentes, a empresa acredita que o intervalo de 11 anos entre os jogos da franquia The Witcher permitirá uma evolução significativa. A promessa é de melhorias em praticamente todos os aspectos da experiência. Durante a reunião, um investidor questionou como The Witcher 4 se compara a GTA 6 , considerando o sucesso comercial e técnico do lançamento da Rockstar. O co-CEO da CD Projekt RED, Michal Nowakowski, ponderou que não seria adequado fazer uma comparação completa entre os dois projetos — mas reconheceu que a equipe acompanha os avanços da concorrência. “Antes de mais nada, esta ligação é sobre nós, não sobre a Rockstar, mas entendo a conexão”, afirmou o executivo. Ele também explicou que a desenvolvedora analisou as diferenças entre GTA 5 e GTA 6 para entender a dimensão da evolução apresentada pela sequência. Nowakowski acredita que uma transformação semelhante poderá ser observada entre The Witcher 3 e o próximo capítulo da franquia. Segundo ele, os 11 anos que separam os dois jogos representam uma grande janela de oportunidade para aprimorar consideravelmente os gráficos, a jogabilidade e outros elementos da experiência. “Acreditamos que haverá um salto comparável entre The Witcher 3 e The Witcher 4 . Já se passaram 11 anos. Estamos trabalhando em The Witcher 4 para torná-lo significativamente mais bonito e aprimorado em praticamente todos os aspectos do jogo”, declarou. O executivo completou: “Então, sim, vocês podem esperar um salto muito maior entre The Witcher 3 e The Witcher 4 ”. Durante a mesma reunião, os investidores também buscaram entender se o lançamento de GTA 6 poderia provocar mudanças no cronograma de desenvolvimento do próximo The Witcher — como ocorreu com outros estúdios alguns meses antes da estreia . A CD Projekt RED, porém, afirmou que não alterou seus planos por causa do jogo da Rockstar. A empresa também reiterou que The Witcher 4 continua previsto para 2028. Até o momento, não existe uma data específica de lançamento, mas a janela já havia sido mencionada anteriormente em atualizações sobre o desenvolvimento do RPG. Outro detalhe envolvendo o projeto é uma parceria de marketing com a Sony. O acordo indica que o PlayStation deverá ter participação importante na divulgação do jogo quando a campanha promocional começar, embora a empresa ainda não tenha apresentado detalhes sobre essa colaboração. Até agora, o público teve acesso apenas a cenas cinematográficas e a uma demonstração técnica que apresentou o jogo rodando no PlayStation 5 . O material mostrou recursos gráficos e desempenho do projeto no console, mas ainda não revelou uma demonstração completa da jogabilidade. A CD Projekt RED também já compartilhou alguns detalhes sobre o tamanho da equipe responsável pelo novo RPG. Em uma atualização publicada antes da Gamescom 2026, Michal Nowakowski confirmou que mais de 500 desenvolvedores estão trabalhando no projeto. “Nossa equipe aqui na sede da CD Projekt RED está trabalhando arduamente em uma saga totalmente nova, com Ciri no comando”, afirmou o executivo. A protagonista será o centro da próxima aventura, que dará início a uma nova fase da franquia. Na ocasião, Nowakowski também descreveu o jogo como o projeto mais ambicioso da história do estúdio. Segundo ele, The Witcher 4 terá um mundo aberto vasto, combates intensos e uma narrativa profunda, com lançamento previsto para 2028. E você, já está ansioso para The Witcher 4 ? sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Out, and There Are Already Black Friday GTA 6 Deals
sources.text: Rockstar's GTA 6 has barely been out for a few days, but UK retailer ShopTo is already offering some surprisingly generous discounts on the new release across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — letting you pay as little as £53.85 for the game. Here's how to save on what's arguably the biggest game of all time. Despite Black Friday still being a week away, the store has slashed £16.14 off the standard Xbox version of Grand Theft Auto VI, bringing its usual £69.99 price down to £53.85 at ShopTo . That's 23% off for a direct digital code, with instant delivery, and no additional vouchers or memberships needed. Better still, there are a few other ways to save on Rockstar's latest blockbuster, depending on whether you're playing on Xbox or PS5, or fancy getting some bonus content with your purchase via the Ultimate Edition As for PS5 players, ShopTo's cheapest route is a little different, since getting digital game keys for PlayStation games outside of boxed codes and PlayStation itself is a lot trickier compared to Xbox titles. Instead of receiving GTA 6 itself, ShopTo can sell you a £70 PlayStation Store gift card for only £60.85 , which you can then redeem on your UK PSN account to buy the £69.99 Standard Edition — effectively earning you £9.15 in savings. On the other hand, for anyone who wants the closest thing to a physical version of GTA 6, both consoles have a £61.85 boxed option with an added A3 double-sided poster ; that also makes ShopTo the cheapest UK retailer to buy the boxed version of Grand Theft Auto VI from right now. Remember, though, these aren't actual disc versions of GTA 6; you'll find a download code inside the packaging instead. Also, for Xbox fans who were considering buying the Grand Theft Auto 6’s Ultimate Edition anyway, ShopTo also has said Ultimate Edition on Xbox for only £67.85 — an incredibly impressive £22.14 price drop and the lowest price we’ve seen for it yet. With the Ultimate Edition, compared to the Standard Edition of GTA VI, you’ll get extra vehicles, weapons, outfits, customisation features, and exclusive locations throughout Leonida. To get that aforementioned Ultimate Edition on PS5, however, you can also grab the £100 PlayStation Store Gift Card for only £85.85 to redeem the complete version of GTA 6 for £89.99. Sure, you’ll only save £41.14 instead of buying the game through the PS Store directly, but you’ll have an extra £10 credit to spend on other games and DLC on top. Otherwise, if you’re unsure about getting the Ultimate Edition on PlayStation 5 right away, you can always buy the £20 Ultimate Edition Upgrade directly from the PlayStation Store . The same goes for the bonus Grand Theft Auto VI Vintage Vice City Pack for £4.49 — featuring the stunning ’55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, alternative outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an exclusive Tropical Weapon Pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm-tree shirt. At the time of writing, there is no physical disc version of GTA 6, along with there being no indication by Rockstar Games as to whether it will be putting out a disc'd edition of the game; with that, these deals are some of the best value you can get on the Grand Theft Auto sequel in the meantime. sources.title: The Normal Person’s Guide To Understanding Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is everywhere you look. Every news channel is talking about it. Celebrities and musicians are playing GTA 6 or posting about its release. It’s apparently the biggest game ever and has sold nearly 40 million copies already . But if you aren’t a big gamer or not a video game fan at all, you might have questions. I have answers. Perhaps someone sent you this link because you kept asking them GTA 6 questions. Maybe you did a Google search, made it past the AI results and found this blog explaining what GTA 6 is to people who don’t buy or play games. Whatever the case, welcome. I’m going to walk you through what is almost certainly the biggest video game launch of the decade , why people are going so wild, and what the game actually is and isn’t. It is an open-world game that mixes together a lot of video game genres, like driving, shooting, and exploration. As with most open-world games, you can run around freely or do story missions. It’s up to the player. You control two characters, Jason and Lucia, who are criminals on the run in fictional versions of Florida and Miami named Leonida and Vice City, respectively. More or less, yeah. The developer, Rockstar Games, has been working on this game since at least 2015 or so. Turns out creating a photorealistic recreation of a chunk of Florida that players can explore and do whatever they want in takes time! No. You can buy it on either PS5 or Xbox for $80. The $100 version comes with a bunch of extra outfits , hairstyles, and other items players can wear or buy in-game using cash they collect from crimes, but it’s definitely not required. It took me about 90 hours to reach the end of the main story. I’ve since played over 150 hours, and I’m still finding new stuff, hearing new songs, and seeing new random events. Yeah, it’s big. Well, a lot of people have been waiting for 13 years to play GTA 6 . The last new GTA game, GTA V , was released back in 2013. So anticipation for this game has been building for a long time. And, surprisingly, GTA 6 lived up to the hype. There are a few reasons for the glowing critical reception. The game’s narrative is really good, featuring two extremely well-written characters that develop a meaningful relationship over the course of its five chapters. Another big reason for the high review scores is just how expansive and reactive the world is. Characters in the game will comment on your clothes, respond to your actions, and remember things you did hours and hours ago. It’s also a lot of fun to play, with challenging but rewarding driving, combat, and police encounters. And it looks incredible, with some of the best graphics ever seen in a console game. Some critics are calling it the best game of the year. And many players are calling it one of the best games ever. GTA: Vice City on the PS2 was much, much smaller and less advanced (though in some ways it was pretty advanced for the time) and was set in the 1980s. While Vice City is a major location in GTA 6 , this is an unconnected and different version of the city from that seen in the original 2002 PS2 game. So many things! Players can steal cars, drive boats, get into fist fights, shoot at the cops, go fishing, play mini-golf, hit the gun range, pet dogs, scuba dive, fly planes, explore the swamps, hunt deer, join in street races, visit the beach, get drunk, buy clothes, play fake video games inside the game, take a shower, eat food, work out, blow up cars, or just chill in a bar. You can also just play through the game’s main story, which is all about Jason and Lucia trying to make some money as criminals to build a life for themselves and their son. Yes, Jason and Lucia have a child, a fact which was omitted from any pre-release marketing but is revealed in the first 20 minutes of the game. During the events of the game, he is living with his aunt while Lucia and Jason do whatever they can to make a good life for him and get him back. She is an attractive but disturbing character players meet very early in the game who may or may not be a serial killer or creepy stalker. Despite this, many people online still want to have sex with her. Some players also think Jason should hook up with Mandy and ditch Lucia. These people are wrong. No. While you can do that stuff, GTA 6 doesn’t force you to be a good boyfriend. You can be a real jerk to Lucia, and she can be a real asshole to Jason. Also, the chores players are talking about only make up a few minutes of the opening hours of GTA 6. The rest of the game has none of that stuff in it. Like the chores mentioned already, these elements are optional. If you constantly skip working out, your characters will eventually become less ripped and might even develop small bellies and thicker thighs. But you can still play all the missions and shoot cops. What? You can totally shoot random people, cops, and more. That’s not accurate. You can shoot, punch, tackle, burn, run over, drown, choke, and slap women. Uhh, you can steal cars. Some cars, like very fancy cars, have special security measures, so you can’t steal them as easily, but you can walk up to any person driving a car at a stoplight, rip them out and take their ride. Okay, so, something you need to understand about GTA 6 is that it is at the center of a massive online culture war. Conservative players, grifters, chuds, and other weirdos are currently spreading false information about this game online. There are also plenty of people online posting inflammatory nonsense to get clicks and engagement on sites like Twitter that reward that shit. So if you read something kind of wild about this game, just know it might be false. Check places like Kotaku or other major gaming sites to verify. Well, actually, Rockstar did remove sex workers you can pay to have sex with from GTA 6 . But there are still strippers in the game. sources.title: Lords of the Fallen 2 delayed to April 2027, release date coming next month
sources.text: The sequel was only announced last summer It's happening. We have some more movement on Lords of the Fallen 2 from CI Games. No, there still isn't a release date, but we know when we're getting one. The action RPG sequel is now due to arrive slightly later than previously announced, but still in the first half of 2027, and we'll be hearing more quite soon. Marek Tyminski, the CEO of CI Games, reveals the details himself. "Lords of the Fallen 2: April 2027," he writes on Twitter . "Exact date in December." What Tyminski's post doesn't specify this that this is actually another delay. The game was originally due in the back half of this year, before moving to the first quarter of 2027 . While it's slightly annoying to only get an announcement for the announcement, at least we know we don't have long to wait to find out when exactly Lords of the Fallen 2 is coming out. Knowing the release month is very helpful too. I could be wrong here, of course, but that seems to all but guarantee the game's presence at The Game Awards. Trailers and reveals are always a big part of the show, and I'm not sure where else we might see the follow-up otherwise, unless CI Games is planning some sort of livestream of its own we're not yet aware of. Regardless of the delay, this is all pretty quick turnaround for the release, since Lords of the Fallen 2 was only announced during the Opening Night Live of Gamescom 2025. Maybe I'm just jaded from increasingly elongated announcement schedules for blockbuster games, but getting the release window only a year and a half after the formal reveal is pretty tight by today's standards. I mean, we just waited years to find out what the full title of The Elder Scrolls 6 is. We'll see what CI Games has to offer come December, which, at time of writing, is just six days away. Maybe Mariah Carey will be involved in some way. I doubt it, but imagine. I bet she loves a bit of Lords of the Fallen, honestly. "Blizzard, I'm looking at you" - Path of Exile 2 boss calls out AAA studios' lackluster game announcements, implores devs to stop trying to have a "'one more thing' moment." Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more Anthony is an Irish entertainment and games journalist, now based in Glasgow. He previously served as Senior Anime Writer at Dexerto and News Editor at The Digital Fix, on top of providing work for Variety, IGN, Den of Geek, PC Gamer, and many more. Besides Studio Ghibli, horror movies, and The Muppets, he enjoys action-RPGs, heavy metal, and pro-wrestling. He interviewed Animal once, not that he won’t stop going on about it or anything. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: GTA 6 players are already starting to get very good at heists, despite all the new challenges Rockstar has added to the game
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 has been out for a little while now, and already players are showing off their skills when it comes to the game's many heists. Despite the challenges in getting away clean, some are proving it's possible. For one, sneaking into a bank while the vault is open and stuffing your bags full of marked bills is a tricky process of gradually making your way through rooms and taking out guards as quietly as possible. While the police in the clip below were called to an eventual breakout of violence, a lengthy getaway allowed for a cheeky payday of almost $100,000 in cash. This crew really cracked a whole bank vault and walked out with almost $100K in GTA 6 💰🏦🚔😮‍💨 #gtavi #gta pic.twitter.com/pJyFXREBvY One especially impressive element of Grand Theft Auto 6 is how many of its little mechanics interact with each other. As you can see below, if you bring a vehicle with a winch to a cash machine, you can actually pull it off the wall and drag it away from the scene of the crime. Why rob a bank in GTA 6 when you can just take the whole ATM💸 How to do it❓ - Hook the ATM up to a vehicle with a winch - Drag it through the streets until the cash cases fall out - Shoot them open and get out fast, the cops come quickly! (via u/MelloYello917) pic.twitter.com/5eXbULJWP3 As you progress through Grand Theft Auto 6, the game actually introduces you to both styles of heists. Without spoiling exactly how this happens, you're told how to go about taking on such criminal ventures, and you can continue to do so throughout the game at your pleasure. Still, even after you've been tutorialised, pulling off one of these heists is no joke, and can easily turn chaotic. This GTA 6 robbery sequence was CRAZY, I couldn't even think straight . pic.twitter.com/l65xSFRoSr Here's a little tip for those of you looking to pull off a heist yourself. You're told that safety deposit boxes can be rifled through for additional loot. However, when you actually make your way into a vault, these will be closed without much sign on which you can access. If you use the focus mode (by pushing in both L3 and R3), it will highlight boxes which you can shoot open. This, of course, may garner unwanted attention, so whether or not you think it's worth doing is part of the risk/reward dilemma you'll have to reckon with. As is the case with so much stuff in GTA 6 including, but not limited to, car-jacking . If you're looking to get your life of crime properly underway, you can read our GTA 6 robberies page for a breakdown on how it works. Alternatively, for a wider view of the game, our GTA 6 walkthrough is the way to go.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: GTA 6 recomp leaders bail out as Take-Two cracks down on illicit efforts to get the game running on PC
sources.text: The leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recreate GTA 6 on PC, have quit the project, although others are still trying to carry it on. Just a day after Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek released the executable for the near-complete Xbox build of the game they dropped on Friday, at least two of the leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recompile it to run on PC, have called it quits—seemingly under pressure from Take-Two and Rockstar. The release of the exe made the pirated Xbox build effectively complete, and that opened the door for recomp projects to do their thing—that is, to leverage AI to quickly whip up a version of the game that will run on PC. Some hackers estimated it could be done within a week; Shayder, one of the lead developers on the Leonida project, said on X that followers could "expect a lot of static recompilation work to be done soon." In a separate message on the Leonida Discord, Shayder tempered expectations a bit, writing that "it will take at least a week" to come up with something playable on PC. During a subsequent livestream, however, the team was seemingly able to get the GTA 6 splash screen to come up on PC, although it crashed after that. It sure seemed like things were moving ahead quickly. But then things began moving quickly in a different direction. "I quit guys. I’m sorry," NotRexed, apparently the head of the project, posted last night on X . "I really want to make cool stuff but every single time shit happens that I can’t control so I’m stepping away. Thank you everybody, especially in the discord that allowed me to have this opportunity." Later, they added , "Last post from me. I wanna clear things up. Rockstar taking my server down was only part of the reason. Like I’ve said before, I’m a 15 year old kid. Managing school and sports is hard enough without having middle aged men yell and complain to you on Discord. Goodbye." In a reply post, NotRexed stated explicitly that "Rockstar shut the server down," and shared an image of the copyright violation notice he'd received from Discord. Shayder, who had previously predicted rapid progress on the Leonida effort following the release of the Xbox executable, took a more direct approach and simply deleted all of their X posts. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. This isn't necessarily the end of work to bring GTA 6 (in a probably not-great state) to PC via AI. Other such projects are underway, and there also appears to be an effort to carry on with Leonida: The website remains up, with a new name attached as owner, and there's at least one Discord server dedicated to it, although it appears a little less focused at this point than the original Leonida server. A new Github repository (NotRexed also deleted that) has been set up: It's "a continuation of NotRexed's Leonida project," according to a note on the project, which adds that "development continues here with its full commit history." The advent of AI greatly simplifies and speeds up the work of bringing console games to PC (as long as you're not too picky about the quality), and that makes life tougher for companies that want to keep a lid on such projects. Still, it's not surprising that Take-Two and Rockstar are going hard on it: In the past, Take-Two has moved aggressively to shut down GTA 5 mod projects, an effort that culminated in its acquisition of the biggest and best of them . I've reached out to Take-Two for more information on the takedown and will update if I receive a reply. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. He began writing videogame news in 2007 for The Escapist and somehow managed to avoid getting fired until 2014, when he joined the storied ranks of PC Gamer. He covers all aspects of the industry, from new game announcements and patch notes to legal disputes, Twitch beefs, esports, and Henry Cavill. Lots of Henry Cavill. sources.title: GTA 6 recompilers and vibe-coders implore AI chatbots to 'work faster' and 'make no mistakes' as they race to get the game running on PC
sources.text: Things continue to get messy in the community of players working on getting Grand Theft Auto 6 working on PC. The previous frontrunner, Project Leonida, got their Discord server and GitHub repository taken down by Rockstar , but others have seemingly stepped in to finish the job. The most up-to-date build of GTA 6 was allegedly leaked earlier this week by notorious leaker CyberLeek . This is a supposedly near-final build of the game's Xbox version, and it's seemingly being used as the basis for the recent work to port the game to PC. Unsurprisingly, most of these communities of modders rely almost exclusively on generative-AI tools like Claude and Antigravity to decompile and recompile the console version of GTA 6. That has always been the case, but the CyberLeek build only invited even more to ask AI chatbots to make the PC port for them. X user chasm has been following developments in the GTA 6 decompile and recompile communities, and recently shared some of the prompts the so-called vibe-coders are using - a few of whom livestreamed the process. "Make no mistakes," one modder prompted the AI chatbot. "Keep finding more stuff and working and pushing," another eloquently asked . "Work faster," asked another . "There has to be a faster way to iterate than this," they continued. Rockstar, which successfully managed to DMCA take down Project Leonida - including all of its 3,006 forks on lead author NotRexed's GitHub - is seemingly also going after people online discussing the community's progress. The X user in question later revealed they may no longer be able to share these updates, as their posts have also been removed "in response to a report by the copyright owner" . As for how far some of the remaining communities have managed to get, this video allegedly shows the game running on PC . This goes beyond the boot-up screen, which modders were able to reach within hours of CyberLeek's build alleged leaking . The footage runs at sub-5fps, but the visuals look to have rendered normally. Assuming Rockstar doesn't also shut down the modders who remain active, we may see another progress update. If you're already playing Rockstar's latest on consoles, the Eurogamer GTA 6 walkthrough offers comprehensive guides on relationship mechanics , how the new Criminal Profile system works , a list of all safe codes and more.

sources.name: Polygon
sources.title: GTA 6 Players Are Running Into a Game-Breaking Bug
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s Leonida is full of dangers: murderous wildlife, over-eager cops, unhinged backwoods drug dealers, terrible drivers, and much more. However, all these threats pale in comparison to a particularly deadly foe. GTA 6 has a game-breaking soft lock bug that makes it impossible to progress. The X user @SirGrotti posted a clip of the glitch, showing how they can no longer switch from Lucia to Jason, with the option permanently grayed out. The glitch can occur in Chapter 3 after the Missing Persons mission, and it’s game-breaking because the next story segment requires Jason. Comments on the post suggest several solutions, including leaving their house and then switching characters, saving and reloading, asking to meet up with Jason, sleeping, and more, but apparently, none of these worked for SirGrotti. Unfortunately, SirGrotti isn't alone. The website GTA6Bugs tracks user-reported cases of crashes, softlocks, and other problems. Of the dozens of bugs logged on the site, the Chapter 3 softlock has the most views. While there are a few fixes that worked for some players, not everyone has been so lucky. The first fix is to load a manual save from before you drove to the warehouse in Port Gellhorn for the final Missing Persons meeting. Then switch to Jason and play through the Dealer’s Choice mission until you can switch to Lucia freely. Make a manual save in a new slot and finish Missing Persons. Beyond this fix, other potential workarounds include playing another Lucia or duo mission if one is available, calling Dunk from Lucia’s phone, and robbing a store as a pair before starting Raul’s job as Lucia. GTA 6 ’s 01.002.002 update didn’t seem to fix this problem, but c onsidering this seems to be one of the most reported game-breaking issues, ideally Rockstar will address it soon. Beyond these softlocks, another common issue for GTA 6 players is a mysterious PS5 crash , which both Rockstar and Sony customer support have blamed on the other party. Things can always be much worse, though: some GTA 6 players have uploaded videos of the game’s demanding graphics seemingly frying their PS5s. One clip from shivjam shows the console dying in real time, while another has a streamer's PlayStation billowing smoke . Console and controller technician Modyfikator89 described GTA 6 as " the toughest real-world PS5 stress test " he had ever seen. With the ongoing chip crisis driving game console prices higher than ever, it's a particularly bad time to be left high and dry.

sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

sources.title: GTA 6 quebra recorde e se torna o maior lançamento da história da PlayStation, confirma Sony
sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 finalmente chegou ao PS5 e Xbox Series X|S na última quinta-feira (19), reunindo milhões de jogadores ao redor do mundo. Além da grande procura pelo novo jogo da Rockstar, a sequência também conquistou uma recepção positiva no Metacritic, tornando-se o único título do século XXI a alcançar média de 99 pontos no agregador . Agora, a Sony confirmou mais um marco para a aventura de Jason e Lucia: GTA 6 se tornou o maior lançamento da história da PlayStation . Segundo a empresa, mais de 39 milhões de jogadores já aproveitaram o game no PS5 desde a estreia. Os números foram divulgados em uma publicação no blog oficial da PlayStation , que também revelou recordes de horas jogadas e consoles conectados durante o período de lançamento. A marca certamente reforça o desempenho comercial do título, que já havia estabelecido recordes de vendas logo no primeiro dia. Segundo a Sony, mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos experimentaram GTA 6 no PS5 desde o lançamento. A empresa classificou o resultado como “o maior lançamento da história do PlayStation”, considerando as três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles da marca. Os dados divulgados pela companhia consideram o período entre a estreia, em 19 de novembro, e o dia 22. Nesse intervalo, os jogadores acumularam 683 milhões de horas de gameplay no console, com uma média de 17,4 horas explorando o estado de Leonida por pessoa. A Sony também confirmou que GTA 6 estabeleceu um novo recorde de jogadores simultâneos em um único jogo na história do PlayStation. A marca superou os números anteriores de títulos multiplayer, gratuitos e até mesmo experiências para um jogador. Outro dado destacado pela empresa foi o número de consoles conectados. Durante o período de lançamento, a PlayStation registrou seu maior volume de PS5 online em um único dia desde a chegada do console, desconsiderando o período de festas de fim de ano. Além disso, GTA 6 foi o primeiro jogo executado em 70% dos novos PS5 conectados entre a estreia e 22 de novembro. O desempenho também acompanha os números divulgados anteriormente pela Rockstar e pela Take-Two . As empresas afirmaram na última sexta (20) que GTA 6 vendeu mais de 32 milhões de cópias em pré-venda e arrecadou US$ 3,79 bilhões no primeiro dia. De acordo com a publisher, o resultado representa um novo recorde de estreia para um produto de entretenimento em qualquer mídia. A empresa também destacou a recepção da crítica, com o jogo alcançando “aclamação universal” e respeitáveis 99 pontos de média no Metacritic. Para se ter noção do feito, GTA 5 arrecadou US$ 1 bilhão nos primeiros três dias de disponibilidade quando foi lançado em 2013. Já Vingadores: Ultimato , um dos maiores sucessos do cinema, levou cinco dias para atingir a mesma marca mundialmente. A Sony aproveitou a publicação para agradecer aos jogadores e parabenizar a Rockstar pelo resultado. “Obrigado por fazer parte deste momento”, declarou a empresa, que também destacou a parceria entre as duas companhias — iniciada ainda na época de GTA 3 no PlayStation 2. sources.title: PlayStation fecha parceria com CD Projekt Red para The Witcher 4
sources.text: A CD Projekt Red anunciou uma nova parceria comercial com a Sony Interactive Entertainment que envolve a campanha de marketing de The Witcher 4 e a distribuição de jogos do estúdio no ecossistema PlayStation . O anúncio foi realizado nesta terça-feira (24), durante a apresentação dos resultados financeiros do terceiro trimestre de 2026 da desenvolvedora polonesa. Segundo Piotr Nielubowicz, diretor financeiro da CD Projekt Red, os acordos foram assinados no mesmo dia e devem contribuir para os resultados comerciais e financeiros da companhia nos próximos anos. Apesar da parceria, o acordo não estabelece exclusividade para The Witcher 4. O RPG continua em desenvolvimento para PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series X|S e PC. A colaboração envolve principalmente a futura campanha publicitária do título, seguindo um modelo semelhante ao adotado pela Sony em sua parceria de marketing com a Rockstar Games para o lançamento de GTA 6. O contrato também contempla a presença de jogos da CD Projekt Red no catálogo do PlayStation Plus . Entretanto, as empresas não divulgaram quais títulos serão disponibilizados no serviço de assinatura. Os valores financeiros e demais condições comerciais do acordo também não foram revelados. De acordo com informações do Video Games Chronicle (VGC), The Witcher 4 segue com previsão de lançamento para 2028. Atualmente, quase metade da equipe de desenvolvimento da CD Projekt Red está dedicada ao projeto. O RPG marcará o início de uma nova trilogia da franquia. Segundo os planos apresentados anteriormente pelo estúdio, a intenção é lançar os três jogos dentro de um intervalo de seis anos. A estratégia representa uma aposta da desenvolvedora na continuidade da franquia e na redução do intervalo entre seus grandes lançamentos. Por enquanto, The Witcher 4 ainda não possui uma data oficial de estreia. Rachele Victoria é formada em Letras, MBA em Inovação e atua há 10 anos com comunicação e conteúdo gamer. stories.summary: Here’s why you should go back to Jason’s house after chapter 1 of GTA 6.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: GTA 6: Here's Why You Should Go Back to Jason's House After Chapter 1
sources.text: Warning: spoilers for Chapter 1 of GTA 6 follow. If you’ve played through chapter one of GTA 6, you’ll know that Jason’s home isn’t in the best of shape following its final mission. On fire, and certainly no place to raise a child, the crib, coffee table, and all of your chosen home improvements are left either shattered or cindered by the time Lucia escapes, taking with her only one valuable: a photo of the couple’s son, Tomás. But not all is lost, and it’s worth going back to check what remains. From the beginning of chapter two onward, going back to Jason’s waterside house can be a risky move to make. Flick open the map, and you’ll see a red area surrounding his immediate neighbourhood that signifies a police presence in the area. Of course, you’re free to head back straight away, but you’ll see a few cop cars sat outside his home, with a few people waiting in case you do return to the scene of the crime. Sneak past them if you trust your stealth skills, or opt for a much quicker and violent smash-and-grab maneuver if that’s more your style. If you're patient, though, that heat will eventually diminish over the course of the story, so you can walk straight through the front door. I’m not exactly sure if that’s tied to your progress through GTA 6’s main missions, or the in-game clock itself, but I can confirm that from around halfway through chapter three, that red zone had disappeared for me. Once inside the ashen remains of Jason’s former quiet life, there are a couple of items of note to grab hold of. Both of these can be found under the floorboards of the bedroom where Jason’s stash once lay hidden. While you won’t be able to recover all of the money you stored there before realising it would be gone forever — I guess it burned, whereas the metal tin next to it protected its contents — you can find both his personal collection of photos and a rainy day fund worth $5,000. The former is a nice extra wrinkle to the story, as Jason and Lucia will make sure to cherish these photos, alongside the one she recovered of Tommy, and carry them with them from home to home around Leonida on their nomadic adventures. The latter is no small amount when starting again from scratch at the outset of chapter two, which does make the risk of getting busted worth it to get a head start in Port Gellhorn. Wait until chapter three, as I did, and that amount of money makes less of a difference. But that isn’t all. When Lucia grapples with the two masked men who set the home on fire, Jason’s pet snake, Dolores, makes a daring escape when her glass enclosure is smashed. We saw her head for the door, but are left wondering whether she managed to dance through the flames to safety. Well, when returning to the home, make sure to check under the back steps, where you can find our serpentine friend alive and well. And she’s not alone either. Get a closer look to find her curled up around some eggs, signalling a whole host of mini Dolores’s are on the way. Perhaps they’ll rebuild this home together, and turn the whole of Key Lento into a snake town over time. Far-fetched, perhaps, but have you seen some of the bonkers sh*t happening in this game? It’s just one example of how Rockstar has managed to build out the world of GTA 6 so successfully, making it feel like a place that carries on living even when you’re not there. This sort of thing is littered throughout Leonida as you progress through the story and the passing of time takes effect. Road and building works that start out as mounds of dirt slowly become more developed as chapters go by, with pipes being laid down and bricks stacked. And Jason’s house isn’t the only place he and Lucia call home that’s worth revisiting long after they’ve departed. The Startlet Motel from chapter two also changes, offering new gameplay and story opportunities. GTA 6 is a game that rewards curiosity, often answering your questions with a satisfying answer, and returning to Jason’s home is just one example of it. sources.title: Everything you should do before the final mission of Chapter 2 in GTA 6
sources.text: Need to know when Chapter 2 of GTA 6 ends? I've explained how the final mission works below The final GTA 6 mission of Chapter 2 sees things go a bit wrong once again, but not quite as catastrophically as the end of Chapter 1. It comes just as Jason and Lucia are on the up having just helped Vicki rob her own boss at Delights, but if you want more specifics on when you can expect to move from Chapter 2 to 3, I've explained below all the important details of the final mission of Chapter 2 and how it affects gameplay with minimal spoilers. The final mission of Chapter 2 in GTA 6 is 'Checking Out' , which pops up shortly after completing the 'Afternoon Delight' mission where you rob Vicki's boss at the Delights strip club. Jason and Lucia will eventually agree they need to pack up and make for Vice City soon, which causes a mission marker to appear on their Starlet Motel room that says, 'Move to Vice City' . Follow this marker and Checking Out will begin as soon as you walk into the motel room, eventually leading straight into the first mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Unlike the GTA 6 Tourist Trap mission and the following ones that wrap up Chapter 1, I and the rest of the GamesRadar+ team have found that completing Checking Out and therefore Chapter 2 does not lock you out of any activities or collectibles – as far as we can tell, nothing is permanently lost from this point and you can come back to it all later. That means you don't need to rush around completing everything in Port Gellhorn and the surrounding areas before going back to the motel as you may have when looking at everything you should do before the end of Chapter 1 in GTA 6 . Illegal operations, Moses' requests such as finding the GTA 6 BF Bandito , and the GTA 6 missing people side quest will remain accessible. The only things to bear in mind are that Jason and Lucia's cars are impounded in Port Gellhorn from the start of Chapter 3 and that the town's heat is incredibly high, making it very dangerous to go back there for a time, though it will eventually clear. You can risk making the trip yourself, but if you have the premium version of the Scooter Bros app, you can get them to retrieve one of your impounded cars. It uses all three of your free daily drop-offs but is well worth it. © GamesRadar+. Not to be reproduced without permission. sources.title: Modders already have GTA 6 running on PC, after CyberLeek released a full Xbox build of the game
sources.text: A PC version of Grand Theft Auto 6 - one from unofficial sources, at least - may be closer than we thought. After suddenly returning last week with a near-full build of the Xbox version , notorious leaker CyberLeek has now posted the missing piece they intentionally held back: the game's executable (.exe) file. "The exe is out. Always free. An early Christmas gift from CL," CyberLeek reportedly wrote, as relayed on Reddit . "The torch passes to the open source re-comp and emulation projects." Hours later, the recompilation modders and hackers part of the Project Leonida Discord server - the current hub for all GTA 6 recompilation efforts - posted footage of the game booting up on PC. In just a matter of hours, modders - with the help of Claude AI - managed to turn the leaked Xbox build into a PC port, of sorts. In this Reddit video , you can see the game boot up to the initial setup before hitting a black screen. The build is clearly not yet playable, though Eurogamer has not directly verified those claims. Shayder, one of the lead developers on Project Leonida, said in a since-deleted post on X that we should "expect a lot of static recompilation work to be done soon." On the project's Discord server, they later clarified that it could take about a week for the build to reach a playable state on PC. As for CyberLeek, the leaker is still soliciting donations for a secret project "for the gamers", adding in the build's readme file , "Nobody has to give anything, and every release stays free either way. But every donation is a vote for more of this, and so is every trade of the token." Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA 6, but the company has historically released its games on PC several months after their console debut. In October, a report said GTA 6's PC version would arrive in the first quarter of 2027 , an unusually short gap between the console and PC releases. These latest recompilation efforts, however, may force Rockstar to speed up development of the PC version. Though the recompiled build may never reach the level of quality or stability of an official port, many of those eager to play the game on PC likely wouldn't care.
